title: OpenPhone Model Decision v3 (router)
description: One decision emitted per model step. v3 is the router shape: it carries mode/reply and does not require a top-level tool field (see main.m: v3 short-circuits tool validation). Legacy v1/v2 single-tool decisions are still accepted by the daemon parser.

mode.description: answer = user-facing reply only; act = run proposed_actions; stop = terminate the loop.

reply.description: User-facing text. Present for answer/stop; optional for act.

task_goal.description: Only set when the request is multi-step.

proposed_actions.description: For mode=act. Each action names a tool from model-tools.json and its arguments.

expected_visible_change.description: Required when the tool drives UI (see model-tools.json drives_ui).

reason.description: Private, brief rationale. Not shown to the user.
